original.title: Technological Pedagogical Content Knowledge: A Framework for Teacher Knowledge
original.venue: Teachers College Record The Voice of Scholarship in Education

core_idea: Teaching with technology needs three kinds of knowledge, technology, pedagogy and content, and above all the knowledge of how they interact in a given subject and context. That intersection is TPACK.
key_concepts_note: Use the concepts already stored for this theory in the library (theories.concepts).
when_to_use: How ready are teachers to integrate technology into their subject teaching?
How does a training programme change teachers' TPACK?
Typical data: TPACK surveys, lesson plans, observation, interviews.
common_mistakes: Measuring only general digital skills (TK) and calling it TPACK.
Treating the seven components as clearly separable when surveys often fail to separate them.
Ignoring context, which the framework itself puts around the model.
